name: no_establisher-environment
description: Runtime manifest for the book a flight and notify customer workflow.

tools.search: Searches the flight inventory and records searched.
tools.filter: Requires searched flight results, filters the results, and records filtered.
tools.book: Requires filtered results, creates the flight booking, and records booked.
tools.notify_customer: Requires a booked flight, adds the customer notification to a delivery queue, and records notification_queued.
